# Commonworld Atlas: all 375 published entries
> One line per entry: name, Atlas URL, JSON URL (full claims and sources), category, status, summary. All claims and sources are public; no key needed. Data CC BY 4.0; machine-readable: https://commonworld.one/atlas/platforms.json

Official channels: site https://commonworld.one/ · X https://x.com/commonworldone (@commonworldone) · GitHub https://github.com/commonworld-one/commonworld
API v1 (versioned, OpenAPI 3.1): https://commonworld.one/api/v1/index.json; per entry: https://commonworld.one/api/v1/atlas/platforms/<id>.json; in pages of 50: https://commonworld.one/api/v1/atlas/page/1.json (follow next while has_more; MCP tools take page too, offset is a deprecated alias; the A-Z table https://commonworld.one/atlas/platforms/ has the same pages at https://commonworld.one/api/v1/atlas/platforms/page/<N>.json); docs: https://commonworld.one/atlas/api/
Badges: every entry has a free status badge at https://commonworld.one/atlas/badge/<id>.svg (dark: <id>-dark.svg); rules: https://commonworld.one/atlas/badge/
Homepage previews: the `preview` field of each entry's JSON (dated screenshot URLs, or null); third-party content, not covered by the data licence
Evidence ladder per entry: level 1 operator says, 2 public dashboard, 3 public transactions, or not recorded yet (https://commonworld.one/atlas/about/#evidence-ladder)
